heroHeadline: US measles cases hit 2,465 in 2026, worst year since 1991, as elimination status review nears
heroSubtitle: 45 jurisdictions affected, 94% of cases outbreak-associated, 3 confirmed deaths since Jan 2025. PAHO's US elimination status decision is due November 2026, after the Americas region lost regional elimination status in November 2025.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
